title: Decoupling and Regulating Modality Heads for Fake News Detection under Missing Modality
abstract: arXiv:2604.09711v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Multimodal news often loses its image or text as it spreads across Web platforms. Existing methods treat this as information loss, assuming that the original veracity label remains valid. This assumption fails for fake news reusing authentic material, whose remainder may be genuine. Detectors should therefore decouple modality cues and adapt their contributions to modality availability. However, coarse news labels provide little guidance for modality decoupling, while training on complete inputs can induce modality bias. To address these challenges, we propose Head-wise Modality Decoupling and Regulation (HMDR) for multimodal large language models. First, Modality Head Decoupling decouples modality representations through soft head grouping by attention preference. translated_title: 缺失模态下假新闻检测的模态头解耦与调控
translated_abstract: 多模态新闻在跨网络平台传播过程中常常丢失图像或文本。现有方法将此视为信息损失，并假设原始的真实性标签仍然有效。然而，这一假设对于复用真实材料的假新闻并不成立，因为其剩余部分可能是真实的。因此，检测器应当解耦各模态线索，并根据模态可用性调整其贡献。然而，粗粒度的新闻标签难以为模态解耦提供有效指导，而在完整输入上的训练又会引入模态偏差。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了面向多模态大语言模型的头级模态解耦与调控方法。首先，模态头解耦通过基于注意力偏好的软性头分组来解耦模态表示；其次，模态头调控通过对不平衡的模态注意力进行补偿来调控各头的贡献；最后，模态不变性学习促进……
tldr: 提出HMDR框架，通过对多模态大语言模型中的注意力头进行模态解耦、贡献调控与模态不变性学习，解决缺失模态场景下假新闻检测的问题，尤其应对复用真实材料导致标签失效的挑战。
en_tdlr: HMDR decouples and regulates modality heads in multimodal large language models through soft head grouping, attention imbalance compensation, and modality invariance learning, enabling robust fake news detection under missing modality.
